proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3245 *kuḍa explicitly gives Palula kuṛī “woman, wife” and Awan kuṛī “woman”. The article debates deeper Munda/Dravidian origin; this link is to the documented Indo-Aryan family, not a claim to have settled the ultimate source.
